title: Reconciliation run record
description: L3-D2 role 'Reconciliation run record' (lanes/L3-06-tasks.md L3-D2 table; contracts_map.py CONTRACTS key run_record). The object each reconciliation run writes. Shape copied verbatim from the already-shipped reconciler.runrecord.RunRecord.to_dict() (reconciler/runrecord.py), whose own docstring names this exact contract as its intended target once L3-D2 resolved. Spec anchor: Section 53.1, 'Every reconciliation run writes its result, and a clean run is recorded as clean.' The canonical store path, schema id and record_schema_version to stamp on a record of this shape are answered by contracts/reconciler/records.yaml (DEC-L3-02-03).

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this reconciliation run.

status.description: Section 53.1 / AT-102: a run that reports zero findings, including the seeded canary, is a FAILED run, not a clean one.

findings.description: Every finding this run raised, each shaped to contracts/reconciler/drift-finding.v1.schema.json (L3-D2 role drift_finding).

comparison_counts.description: Per-comparator compared-row counts (Section 53.1: 'so that a silently narrowed comparison is itself visible drift'). Key is the comparator id.

canary_found.description: Section 53.1: whether the permanent seeded drift record was found this run. False makes the run FAILED regardless of any other finding (AT-102).

external_cause.description: Section 53.1's external-cause paragraph: names an outage or other external cause and marks the run for re-execution.
